description: This plot illustrates the training loss over steps for various models trained on a 20M data size. The x-axis, labeled "Step," features a broken linear scale divided into two distinct segments: the first segment ranges from 0k to approximately 82k with tick marks at intervals of 20k, and the second segment ranges from approximately 420k to 440k with tick marks at intervals of 10k. The y-axis, labeled "Train Loss," also utilizes a broken linear scale divided into a lower segment ranging from 0.0 to just above 0.4 with tick marks every 0.2, and an upper segment ranging from 0.75 to 0.85 with tick marks at 0.75 and 0.85. The plot contains six solid, noisy lines without markers, representing different model configurations. The red line (ChemBART Small 20M), blue line (ChemBART Medium 20M), green line (label obscured by a grey box in the legend), orange line (ChemBERTa Medium 20M), purple line (ChemLLaMA Small 20M), and brown line (ChemLLaMA Medium 20M) all exhibit similar overall trajectories. Each line begins in the upper y-axis segment at a peak of approximately 0.80 to 0.82 near 0k steps, before dropping sharply into the lower y-axis segment. Across the first x-axis segment from 0k to 80k, all lines show a continuous, noisy decline. By 80k steps, the green line reaches approximately 0.10, the red and orange lines reach approximately 0.08, the blue line reaches approximately 0.07, the purple line reaches approximately 0.06, and the brown line reaches approximately 0.05. In the second x-axis segment from 420k to 440k, all lines remain relatively flat and stable; the green line maintains the highest value at approximately 0.05, while the remaining lines are tightly clustered between approximately 0.02 and 0.04 through the end of the plotted range.
